slides.title:
Client paid
late again?
slides.sub:
The 4 emails to send,
and exactly when.

slides.title:
Same day:
send the invoice
slides.text: Send it the day you deliver, while the work is fresh. Always put a due date on it.
slides.box: Due within 14 days of the invoice date.
slides.label: PASTE THIS LINE

slides.title:
1–3 days late:
a friendly nudge
slides.text: Keep it light. Most late invoices are just forgotten.
slides.box: “In case it got lost in your inbox, here it is again.”
slides.label: TRY THIS

slides.title:
About 10 days late:
ask for a date
slides.text: Ask when you can expect the payment. Offer to fix the invoice if something is wrong.
slides.box: “Could you let me know when I can expect it?”
slides.label: TRY THIS

slides.title:
3+ weeks late:
final notice
slides.text: Give one new date. Say that ongoing work pauses until the invoice is paid.
slides.box: Calm and clear. No guilt, no drama.
slides.label: TONE

slides.title:
Let your tracker
count the days
slides.text: Every invoice counts its own late days, so you always know which email is next.
